feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: The law releasing the Epstein files passed one year ago. What do his victims say?
entry.summary: It's been a year since the House passed the Epstein Files Transparency Act, forcing the Justice Department to release millions of files connected to the convicted sex offender. His victims speak out.

entry.title: Why the Nvidia scandal is a national security issue
entry.summary: The Nvidia scandal has spilled over into the Trump administration, which is now under intense scrutiny for how it allowed America's top AI chips to end up in China's hands.

entry.title: Democrats nominate Jeffries for speaker, prep investigations into Trump's orbit
entry.summary: Democrats gave the official nod to Hakeem Jeffries to be the next speaker of the House. Meanwhile, Democrats are ramping up their plans to investigate the Trump administration come January.

entry.title: Democratic strategists think Montana House race could hold the secret to future wins
entry.summary: Montana is sending a Democrat to the U.S. House for the first time in three decades. Many in the party think Sam Forstag's campaign may be a playbook for how Democrats can win again in rural America.

entry.title: Democratic Black women take over almost all state agencies in Georgia soon
entry.summary: In January, most of Georgia's state agencies will be headed by Black women who were all elected in the 2026 midterms.

entry.title: As overdose deaths fall, White House makes misleading claims about who deserves credit
entry.summary: In a statement celebrating the historic drop in drug deaths, the White House pointed to successes since President Trump took office. In fact, the biggest progress happened under the Biden administration.

entry.title: Democrats formally nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker of the House
entry.summary: The New York Democrat moved a step closer to becoming the first Black lawmaker in U.S. history to serve in the job, after House Democrats voted overwhelmingly to support him.

entry.title: House Democrat warns 13 Trump allies to save their records for upcoming investigations
entry.summary: Among the recipients of letters from Robert Garcia, incoming chair of the House Oversight Committee, are Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump, Jared Kushner and White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller.

entry.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
entry.summary: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has won one of the U.S.' most watched Senate races. And, Nvidia's board says it doesn't plan to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang despite pressure from his allies.

entry.title: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
entry.summary: Xi paid Trump a special honor by greeting him on the tarmac after Air Force One arrived in Shenzhen, reciprocating a gesture made by the U.S. president during Xi's visit to Washington in September.
